{{BSE|590086}} | ISIN = INE725E01024 | industry = [[Mining]] | genre = | fate = | predecessor = | successor = | founded = {{Start date and age|1918|08|16}} | founder = Government of India | defunct = | hq_location = [[Bhubaneswar]], [[Odisha]] | hq_location_city = | hq_location_country = India | num_locations = | num_locations_year = | area_served = India | key_people = | products = | production = | production_year = | brands = | services = | revenue = | revenue_year = | operating_income = Rs 29.14 crore | income_year = March 2020 | net_income = | net_income_year = | aum = | assets = Rs 479.45 crore | assets_year = March 2020 | equity = | equity_year = | owner = [https://legislative.gov.in/sites/default/files/A1980-67.pdf Bird Group of Companies] | num_members = | num_members_year = | num_employees = | num_employees_year = | parent = | divisions = | subsidiaries = | module = | ratio = | rating = | website = | footnotes = }} The '''Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited''' ('''OMDC'''), (also known as '''Orissa Minerals'''),{{cite news |last1=Handique |first1=Maitreyee |title=Bird Group to be restructured, 3 subsidiaries to be shut down |url=https://www.livemint.com/Companies/GuBtJrP5M2K9YWkFiHa8DN/Bird-Group-to-be-restructured-3-subsidiaries-to-be-shut-dow.html |publisher=[[Livemint]] |date=April 4, 2007}} is a [[Public Sector Undertaking]] company{{cite news |title=Orissa Minerals Development admitted to CIRP |url=https://www.indiainfoline.com/article/news-top-story/orissa-minerals-development-admitted-to-cirp-120100600414_1.html |publisher=Indiainfoline |date=October 6, 2020}} in the Indian states of [[Odisha]] under administrative control of Ministry of Steel, [[Government of India]].{{cite web |title=Company profile |url=https://www.birdgroup.co.in/omdc/# |publisher=Birdgroup.co.in |accessdate=2020-10-07}} It was founded on August 16, 1918, and is engaged in the mining and production of [[iron ore]] and [[manganese ore]]. It is a subsidiary of state-owned [[Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited]]. It is listed at [[Calcutta Stock Exchange]] (CSE), [[National Stock Exchange of India]] (NSE) and [[Bombay Stock Exchange]] (BSE). == History == OMDC was incorporated on August 16, 1918. In 1980, the company was nationalized by [[Government of India]] through the Bird & Company Limited. It became a [[Public Sector Undertaking]] in March 2010.{{cite web |title=Orissa Minerals Development Company - Company History |url=https://www.business-standard.com/company/orissa-minerals-22980/information/company-history |publisher=[[Business Standard]] |accessdate=2020-10-07}} According to Indian Bureau of Mines approval, it had an annual production capacity of 2.20 million tons of Iron Ore and 0.1 million tons of [[Manganese ore]]. As of March 2016, the net worth of Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited is {{INRConvert|834.91|c|0}}. It ranks #6 in the Top 10 Loss Making CPSEs for 2018–19 with a net loss of {{INRConvert|452|c|0}}, as per the list released by the Public Enterprises Survey, [[Ministry of Heavy Industries and Public Enterprises]].{{Cite web|title=Public Enterprises Survey 2018-19 {{!}} Department of Public Enterprises {{!}} MoHI&PE {{!}} GoI Page No. 5|url=https://dpe.gov.in/public-enterprises-survey-2018-19|last=|first=|date=|website=dpe.gov.in|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2020-05-31}} === Insolvency === In October 2020, OMDC admitted to Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) under the provision of IBC, 2016. The bankruptcy case was accepted by the [[National Company Law Tribunal]] court. Earlier in 2018, the Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP) was initiated against the company, but the case was settled when the company paid creditors' dues. == Mines == It operates six iron ore and manganese ore mining leases, including Dalki Manganese Mines, Kolha Roida Iron & Manganese mines, Thakurani Iron & Manganese Mines, Belkundi Iron & Manganese Mines, Bariaburu Iron Mines hand Bhadrasai Iron & Manganese Mines. The mining leases located are at [[Barbil]] in the district of [[Kendujhar]], [[Odisha]].{{cite news |last1=Moitra |first1=Sumit |title=OMDC settles creditor dues, comes out of NCLT |url=https://www.dnaindia.com/business/report-omdc-settles-creditor-dues-comes-out-of-nclt-2665743 |publisher=[[DNA India]] |date=September 21, 2018}} As of October 2020, the mining operations of Orissa Minerals are under suspension due to non availability of statutory clearances.{{cite news |last1=Himatsingka |first1=Anuradha |title=Operational creditor takes Orissa Minerals Development Company to NCLT |url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/operational-creditor-takes-orissa-minerals-development-company-to-nclt/articleshow/78539164.cms |publisher=[[The Economic Times]] |date=October 7, 2020}} == See also == {{Portal|India}} * [[Public sector undertakings in India]] * [[List of public sector undertakings in India]] ==References== {{Reflist}} {{Public Sector Undertakings in India|state=collapsed}} {{authority control}} [[Category:Government-owned mining companies of India]] [[Category:Indian companies established in 1918]] [[Category:Companies based in Odisha]] [[Category:Mining companies of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the National Stock Exchange of India]] [[Category:Companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange]] {{India-company-stub}}
extract: The Orissa Minerals Development Company Limited (OMDC), (also known as Orissa Minerals), is a Public Sector Undertaking company in the Indian states of Odisha under administrative control of Ministry of Steel, Government of India. It was founded on August 16, 1918, and is engaged in the mining and production of iron ore and manganese ore. It is a subsidiary of state-owned Rashtriya Ispat Nigam Limited. It is listed at Calcutta Stock Exchange (CSE), National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) and Bombay Stock Exchange (BSE).
